note: Marque-neutral VIN decode rules. Every rule carries its source and a verified flag. A rule with verified=false is shown as unverified and never as fact. Anything with no rule stays unknown.

year_codes.source: ISO 3779 / 49 CFR 565.15 model-year code table for VIN position 10 (letters I O Q U Z and 0 unused); same table as cuore.services.landing_bridge

check_digit.source: 49 CFR 565.15 requires the position-9 check digit for North American vehicles; ISO 3779 does not require it elsewhere, so it is advisory outside North America

wmi.source: cuore.services.shop_bridge._WMI_MAKES; confirmed against the owner's reference VIN ZASFAKPN5J7B88115. Market not stated by the WMI, so unknown.
https://dot.report/wmi/ZN6 : held by Maserati North America, Inc. (cited in mes.platform)
cuore.services.shop_bridge._WMI_MAKES (make only). mes.platform notes no source was found assigning ZN7 to a model or market.
Not confirmed in this repo: DESIGN.md (2026-10-31) says Ferrari WMI needs a real VIN and an authoritative list. Shown as unverified.

models.source: mes.platform.model_for_vin (WMI ZASF -> stelvio), confirmed against ZASFAKPN5J7B88115 only. Platform text comes from mes.platform.platform_for.
mes.platform: ZN6 is used for both Levante and Grecale and no sourced VIN position separates them, so the model stays unknown.
mes.platform: no source assigns ZN7 to any model, so the model stays unknown.

plants.source: Stelvio is built at Cassino (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alfa_Romeo_Stelvio); that VIN position 11 value 7 means Cassino is NOT confirmed from an authoritative plant-code list.
